prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection in Baytown, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had been green for me.

Q: Okay. What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the cross street on my right didn't stop. It hit the passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt and my car spun a little before it stopped.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not really. I only noticed it a split second before it hit me. I braked, but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, but I was sore right away. My lower back was tight and it's gotten worse since then. I went to urgent care the same day.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain?

A: Yes, it's mostly in the lower back and it gets stiff when I sit for long periods. I've been doing some stretches and taking over-the-counter medication.

Q: Did you have any back problems before the collision?

A: No, nothing that required treatment. I'd had a bit of stiffness after long shifts, but nothing like this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm willing to provide my medical records and whatever else you need to process the claim.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.
